newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended lower in all months on Monday, after the stronger yen against the dollar offset the Chicago corn market's price gains, traders said.
Prices were 60 to 390 yen lower, with benchmark May 1998 closing steady at 13,980 yen per tonne. The day's estimated trade volume was 48,624 lots.

Light selling from individual investors capped the topside throughout the day, traders said. "The market mood is bearish now, after the distant month fell below the 14,000 yen levels," a brokerage house trader said.
At 0750 GMT, the spot May corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was at $2.84-1/4 per bushel, down from the $2.88-1/4 Friday close.
The spot May soybean contract on the CBOT overnight trading system stood at $8.60 per bushel, against the previous close of $8.66-3/4.
